answer_sentences.text: A loan of ₹25,00,000 opens the door to a place called home.
answer_sentences.quote: "Loan" means the loan of ₹25,00,000 granted under this Agreement

answer_sentences.text: Each month, the EMI arrives like a steady heartbeat on the 10th day.
answer_sentences.quote: "EMI" means the equated monthly instalment specified in Schedule I; (c) "Due Date" means the 10th day of each calendar month

answer_sentences.text: When part pre-payments come softly, the principal grows lighter.
answer_sentences.quote: Part pre-payments shall be applied towards the principal outstanding.

answer_sentences.text: And by quarter’s end, the bank sends a quiet tally of what remains and what has been repaid.
answer_sentences.quote: The Bank shall make available to the Borrower, at the end of each quarter, a statement showing the principal and interest recovered till date, the EMI amount, the number of EMIs left and the annualised rate of interest for the entire tenor of the Loan.
